# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

 

 

## Where we’re making news

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers
are making news around the globe. Here are some of the latest stories.

[More News][62]

## Karriere bei der Emsland Group

Die Emsland Group kombiniert die Bodenständigkeit eines lokalen Unternehmens mit der weltweiten
Vermarktung einer internationalen, mittelständischen Unternehmensgruppe. Wir bieten an sieben
Produktionsstandorten in Deutschland und mit über 120 Repräsentanzen weltweit bemerkenswerte
Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen Entwicklung. Unsere Einstiegsmöglichkeiten reichen vom Praktikum über
diverse Ausbildungsplätze und Stellenangebote in der Grafschaft Bentheim und weit darüber hinaus. 

[ Mehr erfahren ][41]

## Über uns

Seit über 90 Jahren produzieren wir für einen weltweiten Markt Qualitätsprodukte, „Made in Germany“.
Aus dem nachhaltigen Rohstoff der Kartoffel und Erbse optimieren wir Produkte des täglichen Lebens.
Wir sind Spezialist für Stärkeveredlungsprodukte, Kartoffelflocken und
-granulate, Proteine wie auch Fasern.

[ Mehr erfahren ][42]

## Unsere Lieferanten

Eine enge und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Landwirten ebenso wie mit unseren
Zulieferern und Dienstleistern ist die Voraussetzung, um zukunftsweisende Kartoffelprodukte im
Einklang mit der Natur zu entwickeln. Darüber hinaus sind wir sehr stolz auf die Wiedereingliederung
der Emsland-Service GmbH in unsere Unternehmensgruppe der Emsland Group.

# Texture that transforms every bite

See how our collaborative approach turns concepts into next-level sensory experiences

[Explore texture innovations][1]

Mobile Image

## Formulate with our versatile ingredient solutions that help you exceed consumer expectations for
## amazing taste and better nutrition

Ingredion is your ideal partner in developing the future of food, empowering you to create consumer
preferred products that offer exceptional eating experiences with the on-trend benefits they desire.

### Unlock consumer-preferred sweet taste without artificial sweeteners

New PureCircle Clean Taste Solubility Solution (CTSS) is a patented technology offering improved
taste performance, cleaner labels and is 100 times more soluble than Reb M.

[Learn more][2]

[Picture 1118121461]

We can also help you accelerate your sustainability initiatives with our tailored ESG solutions
specific to food and beverage manufacturers. Ingredion's sustainable innovation and regenerative

propel our customers in meeting their environmental, social and governance commitments.

## Be what’s next™

In a world that rewards the agile, inventive and sustainable, Ingredion has the people, proficiency
and passion to help you anticipate what’s next and succeed.

### What you should know before using a sugar substitute for baking

Learn how sugar substitutes impact baking beyond sweetness. Explore consumer demand, stevia and
allulose functionality, and tailored sweetener systems for better texture, moisture and shelf life

[Learn more][20]

[Sliced fresh lemon with juicy segments and green mint leaves on a rustic wooden table, highlighting
vibrant citrus fruits and natural ingredients for healthy recipes and refreshing beverages]

### Citrus fiber gains ground as clean label solution to complex challenges

Citrus fiber is transforming clean label innovation across food categories. Discover how Ingredion’s
FIBERTEX™ CF helps brands improve functionality, reduce costs and meet sustainability goals in
bakery, beverage, plant-based and savory applications

[Learn more][21]

### Clean label ingredients: From buzzword to business driver

Clean label has become the new industry standard, driven by consumer demand for transparency, simple
ingredients, and premium sensory experiences. Learn how Ingredion empowers brands in bakery,
beverage, and savory categories with functional starches, fibers, and scalable clean label solutions
that maintain taste and performance

[Learn more][22]

# Willkommen bei Berolan^{®}

 Luftporenbilder von BEROLAN tragen maßgeblich zur leichteren Verarbeitung und verminderten
Rissbildung von Putzen und Mörteln bei. Unsere zertifizierten Produkte können staubfrei in die
Vorratsbehälter eingebracht werden und erzeugen ein feines stabiles Luftporensystem. Das Verhalten
von Baustoffen wird somit besonders positiv beeinflusst. Die Benetzbarkeit des trockenen
Baustoffgemisches wird gefördert und die Dispergierwirkung der anderen Rohstoffe wird
erhöht. Zusätzlich werden die Ergiebigkeit und die offene Zeit verbessert.

## Das Wichtigste auf einen Blick

# Unsere Misson:
# Locker und leicht

Wir wollen es Ihnen leichter machen. Für höchste Ansprüche bei der Verarbeitung von Putzen und
Mörteln erzeugen wir unsere effizienten Luftporenbilder. Ganz individuell produziert und bestens
kontrolliert sind BEROLAN Produkte mittlerweile für viele Kunden weltweit ein unverzichtbarer
Bestandteil Ihrer Formulierungen.

# Von Arbing in
# die ganze Welt

Als echtes österreichisches Familienunternehmen agieren wir international und setzen auf Erfahrung
und besonderen Service für unsere Kunden. Mit individuellen Mischungen und Abfüllung gehen wir auf
die speziellen Leistungsanforderungen unserer Kunden ein.

# Unser Anspruch –
# höchste Qualität

Wir garantieren im Rahmen der Qualitätskontrolle durchgängige Standards für alle verwendeten
Materialien und Mischungen. Laufende externe Überwachungsaudits und modernste Prüfverfahren
ermöglichen präzise Messergebnisse und mehr Kundenzufriedenheit.

## Erleben Sie BEROLAN

Blättern Sie gerne in unserer **interaktiven Broschüre** und erfahren Sie alles rund um unsere
effizienten, lösungsorientierten Trockenmörteladditive.

erhöht. Zusätzlich werden die Ergiebigkeit und die offene Zeit verbessert.

# Unsere Misson:
# Locker und leicht

Wir wollen es Ihnen leichter machen. Für höchste Ansprüche bei der Verarbeitung von Putzen und
Mörteln erzeugen wir unsere effizienten Luftporenbilder. Ganz individuell produziert und bestens
kontrolliert sind BEROLAN Produkte mittlerweile für viele Kunden weltweit ein unverzichtbarer
Bestandteil Ihrer Formulierungen.

# Von Arbing in
# die ganze Welt

Als echtes österreichisches Familienunternehmen agieren wir international und setzen auf Erfahrung
und besonderen Service für unsere Kunden. Mit individuellen Mischungen und Abfüllung gehen wir auf
die speziellen Leistungsanforderungen unserer Kunden ein.

# Unser Anspruch –
# höchste Qualität

Wir garantieren im Rahmen der Qualitätskontrolle durchgängige Standards für alle verwendeten
Materialien und Mischungen. Laufende externe Überwachungsaudits und modernste Prüfverfahren
ermöglichen präzise Messergebnisse und mehr Kundenzufriedenheit.

## What does Bluecraft Agro specialise in?

Bluecraft Agro is a leading starch manufacturer in India, specialising in specialty starches, native
starches, modified starches, starch derivatives, and sorbitol derived from maize, rice, potato, and
tapioca. As one of the trusted modified starch manufacturers in India, we deliver solutions tailored
to diverse industrial needs.

## Which industries do your products serve?

As a prominent starch company in India, Bluecraft Agro supplies high-quality starch solutions to
food & beverage, confectionery, pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, skincare, paper & board, textiles,
bioplastics, oil & gas, and animal nutrition industries worldwide.

## What types of starch grades and derivatives do you offer?

We are among the reliable bulk starch manufacturers offering native starches, modified starches,
specialty starches, maltodextrin, liquid glucose, sorbitol, and other starch derivatives from maize,
potato, rice, and tapioca. Our expertise also makes us a preferred choice for corn starch
manufacturers in India.

# Welcome to drymix.info

Dear Visitor

Welcome to **drymix.info, the International Community for Drymix Mortars**. In March 2025, we were
proud to welcome our 11.000th subscriber for the **[newsletter][34],** and we have now more than 200
registered members. Without your participation, drymix.info would not be possible, [we encourage you
to join us as member or partner][35].

Ferdinand Leopolder, München

   processes, we ensure the production of tapioca starch with optimal performance.

   international markets.

#### Welcome to Industrial Specialties

Industrial Specialties, LLC is an exclusive distributor of Avebe products in North America.  We
supply modified potato starch, dextrins, and starch derivatives to many industrial markets. These
starches and dextrins are treated, customized, and categorized for specific uses.  Generally
speaking, glue manufacturers and other adhesive users are our largest consumer. Avebe's range of
dextrins is used for envelope adhesives, laminating, mucilage (gum) , bottle labeling, tube winding,
and case/carton sealing. Our customers use Avebe products to mix paste for bill posting, target
shooting, and wallpaper/murals.  There are many other fascinating uses for our products in the arts
and craft industry as well as in the textile industry.   We even have an earth friendly product used
in water treatment plants.  Modified potato starch is a renewable, sustainable, and biodegradable
raw material with unique properties in viscosity, binding, tack, and film forming. 



By nature, starch from the potato has the highest wet tack of all starches.

Potato starch is also a natural polymer. Increasing it’s use reduces the long-term dependency on
petroleum-based raw materials. Our raw material produces the "greenest adhesive on earth."

We invite you to explore our website to learn more about our industry

[Find out more][13]

## #1 Target Paste

[image100]

 If these targets don’t hold up to the wind and rain, then that nice clear white paper comes flying
off and we fail our mission. At WTB Quantico, we use Viscogel to adhere the targets to the backing
boards for target practice.

About Us

SANTOCHEM is a professional concrete additives manufacturer, we have been committed to the
development, production, sales and technical service in concrete additives for long time. Products
are mainly all kinds of concrete admixtures, various functional admixtures for cement and gypsum
based mortar and special mortar, including Powder Polycarboxylate Superplasticizer, Mother Liquid
PCE, Defoamer, Sodium Gluconate, Gypsum Retarder, Fibers and so on, widely exported to South
America, the Middle East, Russia and Southeast Asia Market.
SANTOCHEM grew up in the period of rapid development of Chinese infrastructure, we are not only the
witness of Chinese speed, but also the participant of Chinese speed. In the long-term practice, the
technicians have accumulated rich experience, and their continuous upgrading of products have
created excellent quality. Our company has a complete quality control system, with product research
and development center, admixture lab, concrete lab, dry mix mortar lab, QC center. Quality control
is throughout the whole process of product design, manufacture, inspection and application. At
present, our company has passed ISO9001, ISO14001, 3C and GB/T28001.
Our products are used in Chinese national key projects, some have been finished, and some are still
under construction that includes QINGDAO METRO, RIZHAO HIGH-SPEED RAILWAY STATION, SHANDONG IRON AND
STEEL GROUP FACTORY, QINGYIN PHASE I HIGHWAY and many other projects.
SANTOCHEM is proud of being a manufacturer, and our mission is to be a useful enterprise to the
society. In the future, our company will increase more input for reformation and innovation, reply
on leading technology to expand more market, adhere to the integrity of the service to win the trust
of all customers.****

## About Starch

Starch is a carbohydrate extracted from agricultural raw materials, which is widely present in
literally thousands of everyday food and non-food applications. It is the most important
carbohydrate in the human diet.

The European starch industry provides their customers with a broad portfolio of safe and
high-quality products ranging from native starches, modified starches, liquid and solid sweeteners
to oils, proteins and fibers that are used as ingredients and functional supplements in a wide array
of applications.

[more][8]

## OUR 5 KEY MESSAGES

## OUR 5 KEY MESSAGES

### Our thoughts on the role, impact, and responsibilities of the Starch Industry

## 1. Innovation

The European starch industry is built on constant innovation

The European starch industry is a long-established part of the agri-food value chain, built on
constant innovation to meet societal demands and consumer expectations.

[More][9]

## 2. Rural Strength

We strengthen rural areas with essential sources of income and employment

We strengthen rural areas by providing an essential source of income and employment, both directly
and to the farmers who supply the raw materials used to make our ingredients.

[More][10]

## 3. Plant-based

We offer a vast range of plant-based ingredients improving food and drink.

We offer a vast range of plant-based ingredients, including carbohydrates, proteins and fibres, to
make food and drink taste better, last longer, and be more sustainable and nutritious.

[More][11]

## 4. Bioeconomy

We develop bio-based materials and alternatives to fossil-based products

We develop bio-based materials and alternatives to fossil-based products in industrial applications
from renewable resources, offering functional properties and CO2 emission reductions.

[More][12]

## 5. Sustainability

The EU starch industry is a pillar of the sustainable food system.

By valorising the entire crop to serve food, feed and industrial customers, while reducing our
environmental footprint, the EU starch industry is a pillar of the sustainable food system.

[More][13]

##### Corn Starch

Corn starch, also known as maize starch or corn starch (American English), is a starch derived from
the endosperm of the corn (maize) grain. Corn starch is a versatile and essential ingredient widely
used in food applications for its exceptional thickening, stabilizing, and binding properties.
Derived from the endosperm of corn kernels, it is a natural, gluten-free product suitable for
various dietary needs.

In food production, corn starch is commonly used as a thickening agent in soups, sauces, gravies,
and puddings, providing a smooth and glossy finish. It enhances the texture and consistency of baked
goods by contributing to moisture retention and creating a tender crumb. Corn starch is also an
effective anti-caking agent in powdered products and serves as a key ingredient in batter and
coating formulations to improve crispness.

With its neutral taste and versatility, corn starch is a vital component in developing high-quality,
innovative, and consumer-friendly food products.

##### Pea Starch

Pea starch is a natural, plant-based starch derived from yellow peas, offering unique functional
properties for a wide range of food applications. Known for its clean label appeal, pea starch is
gluten-free, non-GMO, and suitable for vegan and allergen-conscious diets.

In food applications, pea starch is valued for its excellent thickening and gelling capabilities,
making it ideal for use in soups, sauces, gravies, and processed foods. It enhances the texture and
consistency of products, offering a smooth and creamy mouthfeel. Pea starch also has good
water-binding properties, which help in moisture retention, extending the shelf life of baked goods,
dairy alternatives, and snack foods.

Moreover, pea starch acts as a stabilizer in emulsions and can improve the crispiness of fried
products by forming a protective coating. Its mild flavor and adaptability make it a versatile
ingredient in creating healthier, more sustainable food products without compromising on quality or
taste.

appearance of various food products.
